name: CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet
author: cyberforest

sections.description:
CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet adds a Guitar Chord Sheet block to the block editor.
Enter chord markers anywhere in the lyrics, for example:

[C]Your lyrics [G/B]continue here

For a custom fingering, enter six strings from low E to high E:

[Cadd9|x,3,2,0,3,3]Your lyrics

Use x for a muted string, 0 for an open string, and a number for a fret.
Diagrams are generated as accessible inline SVG and remain sharp at any size.

Built-in minor seventh diagrams include natural, sharp, and flat names such as
Am7, C#m7, Dbm7, Ebm7, and Bbm7. Use the lowercase letter b when
entering a flat chord name.

The plugin works entirely on your WordPress site. It does not contact external
services, create user accounts, collect usage data, or load remote assets.

All plugin code is licensed under GPLv2 or later. No third-party libraries,
fonts, images, or icon sets are bundled.

Privacy

CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet does not collect, store, or transmit personal data. It
does not contact external services, create accounts, or load remote assets.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet.
  3. Add the Guitar Chord Sheet block to a post or page.
  4. Enter lyrics and chord markers in the block.
sections.faq:
Which chords are built in?

Version 0.1.1 includes common major, minor, seventh, major seventh, minor
seventh, and selected slash chord fingerings. Minor seventh fingerings support
natural roots and sharp/flat aliases.

How do I enter sharp and flat chord names?

Use # for a sharp and the lowercase letter b for a flat. For example,
enter [C#m7] or [Dbm7]. The plugin treats supported enharmonic names as
aliases for the same fingering.

Can I create a custom chord?

Yes. Use [Name|string1,string2,string3,string4,string5,string6].
Strings are ordered from low E to high E.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • Rename the plugin to CyberForest Guitar Chord Sheet and update its text domain for the requested WordPress.org slug.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Add a dynamic Guitar Chord Sheet block for the visual editor.
  • Render accessible SVG chord diagrams above lyrics.
  • Include common chords, slash chords, and natural/sharp/flat minor seventh chords.
  • Support custom six-string fingerings.
